scenarios.title: Real five-ETF snapshot and equal-weight baseline
scenarios.expected: A shared real snapshot for 511260, 518880, 515080, 513300 and 159612 with official exchange calendar, verified corporate actions and price basis, point-in-time availability evidence, frozen 60/20/20 partitions and a Discovery equal-weight baseline that a second researcher can reproduce from the same approved inputs.
scenarios.observed: A real snapshot was sealed and baselined outside Git: snapshot ID b07823329f95b2f3d6a8d7e5fb7660941eda25150dc2b7a3ae8086357e02d41d, schema 2, data_kind real, 1,094 sessions 2022-05-20..2026-11-20, partitions 656 Discovery / 218 Validation / 220 Final Holdout, 5,470 raw bars, 5,470 derived values, 20 official cash dividends and 211 hashed evidence items (official calendars, listings, dividends, halts, price archive samples). The Discovery equal-weight baseline (5 bps / 0 slippage, then 20 bps / 10 bps) filled all five ETFs on 2022-05-23 and ended at 155,603.3472 / 155,215.1928 with two declared unknown-NAV days (159612 full halts on 2025-01-10 and 2025-01-24). An independent Agent recomputed all 656 Discovery sessions in a read-only Colima container. @ZombieIce accepted both cost configurations within tolerance and both unknown NAV dates on 2026-11-22. Regular session times follow the agreed 09:30/15:00 assumption subject to actual halts. The daily prices are a vendor reconstruction with seven dated archive samples.

evidence.description: Sealed schema-2 real snapshot outside Git: 1,094 sessions, 656/218/220 partitions, 5,470 raw bars, 5,470 derived values, 20 official dividends, 211 SHA-256-verified evidence items. Official listing/calendar/dividend/halt sources; prices are a current vendor reconstruction.

Discovery-only equal-weight baseline at 5 bps / 0 and 20 bps / 10 bps: five fills on 2022-05-23, ending NAV 155,603.3472 / 155,215.1928, two declared unknown-NAV days from 159612 full halts, no deferred fills and no stale marks.

Independent standard-library recomputation from the sealed snapshot: derived values, fills, fees, dividend cash, every NAV point and the gap sets match exactly within pre-registered tolerances. This is a machine cross-check, not the independent human researcher #24 requires.

Official five listing announcements, five SSE annual notices plus 59 SZSE month calendar responses, 20 dividend PDFs, 118+2 159612 and 43 513300 halt notices, and seven sampled TDX dated packages; all hashed in the snapshot evidence block. Vendor qfq/hfq was not used as the total-return series.
Trusted operator verified the single read-only Discovery mount and seven inaccessible source or protected paths in the isolated calculation.

Independent Agent computed the baseline using the approved Discovery input. @ZombieIce accepted the two cost scenarios and the 2025-01-10 and 2025-01-24 halt gaps. Comparison receipt SHA-256 4cde8098f699c0665e6fb17ac9dddaa82c987f28813cdd57784de5059acc574e.

scenarios.title: Real-data bounded Mock campaign
scenarios.expected: A bounded fixed-Mock, fixed-config and fixed-seed campaign on the real Discovery partition with hypotheses, parent/child experiment IDs, receipt-driven iterations, deterministic diagnostics, failure and budget records, and an interrupted-then-resumed run that matches the uninterrupted run without duplicate attempts or lost records.
scenarios.observed: The fixed deterministic Mock (seed 1) ran on all 656 approved Discovery sessions in two isolated campaigns. Both recorded three linked submissions with identical decisions, Discovery results and diagnostics. The interrupted second experiment reported EXECUTION_INTERRUPTED and resumed under its original ID. Both budgets reconciled to three attempts with replay idempotency and fourth-attempt refusal. The research container had only the Discovery project copy and could not open the protected paths. The evidence is limited to historical real data and a fixed Mock.

evidence.description: Synthetic mechanism coverage only: Mock iterations, idempotent submission, resume, failure evidence and budget accounting. This proves the protocol, not real Discovery execution.

Full result comparison SHA-256 74fca7201a6c3f52b7cc5c1d175a4d0f3dee925392144024595094d3cce8d6e9. Separate control and resumed projects record the hypotheses, parent links, interruption, stable experiment ID, diagnostics, attempt and execution-time budgets, and OS-level access probes.
